entries.summary: Manage independent repository catalogs and per-application release downloads in one screen
Remove Updater user authentication and central cross-repository distribution workflows by explicit operator instruction

recovery_conditions: Preserve settings, data, Jobs, journals and the original pinned supervisor runtime. Inspect active work and actual versions before updating. Unknown effects stop without replay; recover through an independent administrator channel.
